tools.name: pulse_base_liquidity
tools.description: Base token liquidity observations, measured pool balance changes after warm-up, and unsigned amount-specific USDC quotes for $100, $1,000 and $10,000, pinned to one verified Base block. Coverage and quote provenance are included.

tools.name: pulse_polymarket_velocity
tools.description: Sampled active Polymarket outcomes with real CLOB depth, sorted bid/ask spreads and five-minute probability movement from acquired price history. Missing history is explicit; price movement does not identify a trader or whale.

tools.name: pulse_threat_intel
tools.description: GoPlus-reported risk assessments for a stated sample of Base tokens, with acquisition times and evidence hashes, plus scoped deterministic text sanitization. Unknown assessments and unavailable spender reputation remain explicit.

tools.name: pulse_arb_routes
tools.description: Unsigned, amount-specific Base round-trip route quotes across distinct supported pools at one verified block. Gross spread includes quoted pool fees; unproven gas, taxes, execution and MEV costs are not represented as net profit.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pulse_base_liquidity" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read-only oracle providing real-time Base DEX pool reserve deltas, 60s netflow velocity, and slippage quotes for $100, $1k, and $10k." → after: "Base token liquidity observations, measured pool balance changes after warm-up, and unsigned amount-specific USDC quotes for $100, $1,000 and $10,000, pinned to one verified Base block. Coverage and quote provenance are included."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
